Description:
With a resounding impact, the greatsword cleaves through the air, connecting with the beast's tail in a mighty blow. The wyvern wheels around, its massive jaws primed to ensnare the warrior in their deadly embrace. In a daring maneuver, the fighter relinquishes her blade, seizing the wyvern's jaw in a vice-like grip, diverting its momentum towards a nearby tree. She ascends onto the creature's head, plunging her blade deep into its eye with lethal precision. It is then that you observe a miraculous sight: her previously bloody wounds have miraculously sealed, as if cauterized by the scorching heat of battle and the coursing adrenaline of combat.
Warriors are talented in using any type of weapon, with hand-to-hand combat capabilities way beyond the average adventurer. Brawn and tactics are a warrior's aces in the sleeve.
A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Quick Note: A warrior is a physical combatant, but that does not stop them from overcoming challenges. With mastery over arms, body or range, a warrior may improvise and lead their way to victory.
Weapons: You are Trained in all weapons, including Shields.

Mana.Regain: You regain all Mana back inbetween Adventures.

Spellcasting.Change: You can change your known Spells and Talents inbetween Adventures.
Spellcasting.Other: All Warrior-specific Abilities are not considered Spells (unless stated otherwise).

~War Fierce~.Effect:
Once per Turn, certain attacks may become {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}. {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks deal +1d4 Damage.
Choose your Fierce Craft from below!
~War Fierce~.Upgrade: You may change your Fierce Craft inbetween Adventures.

Other Abilities Description: Choose one of the following Fierce Crafts that will change your playstyle!

~Shield Craft~.Effect: Use after you are melee attacked. Make a {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attack against it for 1 base Smash Damage.
~Shield Craft~.Combo: And Slam it that many meters away from you.

~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'old-fashioned*')} weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}, {Color('#ff5900' 'and also applies a ~Combo~ if the target is a Person')}.
~Old-Fashioned Craft~.Upgrade: Old-fashioned weapons are weapons that do not deal extra Damage with any Stat (e.g. Hammer).

~Dualwield Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second 1')} {A}{Color('#ff5900' '{A}Action Point')} attack with a real weapon each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if it is with a different weapon than the first attack')}.

~Heavy Weapon Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' '2')} {A}{Color('#ff5900' '{A}Action Points')} weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is an Ally, obstacle or wall directly behind your target')}.

~Throw Craft~.Effect:
You may {Color('#ff5900' 'throw')} real melee weapons with a 3-5 meter range.

If your first Act each Turn is a {Color('#ff5900' 'thrown')} weapon attack, it is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}.

~Unarmed Craft~.Effect: Your {Color('#ff5900' 'second Unarmed Combat*')} attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}. If it {Green('Critically Strikes')}, your next one is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} as well.
~Unarmed Craft~.Upgrade: You gain the Unarmed Combat Feat without spending the cost. You can find it on the `Feats page$/Other/Feats`.

~Marksman Craft~.Effect: Your first ~ranged~ weapon attack each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if there is no Unit or obstacle near the target')}.

~Dual Shield Craft~.Effect:
You can Dual Wield shields and attack with them for 1d6 + ^Might or Instinct^ Damage.
Your first one each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')}.

~Improvisation Craft~.Effect: Your first {Color('#ff5900' 'Improvised* attack')} each Turn is {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} {Color('#ff5900' 'if you have never used that object as a weapon')}.
~Improvisation Craft~.Upgrade: You gain the Unarmed Combat Feat without spending the cost. You can find it on the `Feats page$/Other/Feats`.

~Vault Break~.Effect: Slam the ground so hard that it shatters one obstacle that fits within a 3x3x3 meter area.
~Vault Break~.Notes: It is the Quest Master's call if an obstacle can be broken. Most walls can't be broken, except for thinner ones and fences.

~Sound Mind~.Effect:
Take 2d4 Damage.
Block any non-damaging negative incoming _effect_ on another ally you can see.
~Sound Mind~.Upgrade: Negative effects in this case means any Control Effect, Debuff, Curse, mind-altering magic, non-Damaging Poison, etc.

~Command - Resist~.Effect:
Use when another Ally would take Damage.
They don't take the Damage now. They take it at the end of their Turn.
~Command - Resist~.Notes: You can use dice and put them on their Hero Sheet to track that they will take the Damage later.

~Snap Out Of It~.Effect: Attack a different Unit with a One-Handed weapon. Any of its Damage becomes Healing instead.
~Snap Out Of It~.Notes: Any extra Damage effects on it Heal as well (e.g. Fierce Craft, Criticl Strikes, etc). Apply any weapon effects if they happen. The attack might still do Healing to other collateral Units (if applies, e.g. Cleaver, Smite, etc).

Starting Abilities Description.Fierce Craft:
Your Fierce Craft is your bread-and-butter feature. Use it optimally to deal more Damage in Combat!
There are many ways you can optimize how you deal this Damage, depending on the style of fighting you like, be it sword-and-board, using an Ultra Greatsword, or punching your way to victory!

Starting Abilities Description.Charge: Charge is a way to get free movement on your Turn, even every Turn! Note that Charge has an exact range of 2 meters, so you can't move less than that. You can, however, Charge 2 meters to move next to an Enemy that's only 1 meter away, if you land a bit farther back.

Specializations.Description: At Level 1, you can choose your specialization. Every Warrior can choose from the following Warrior specializations
Choices: Fighter, a person specialized in weapon fighting and body-to-body combat
Battlemaster, a heavily trained and armed warrior; master yourself - master the enemy
Barbarian, a crude and battle thirsty warrior, who seeks to shed blood and lives for the fight
Marksman, a precise and mechanical soldier, always finding the best tactic and position; the Marksman wins the battle before it begins

<Ruining Throw>.Effect: Throw a weapon at a target and attack it (without Throwing penalties and ignoring Cover).
<Ruining Throw>.Downside: TODO - Make this more interesting. Also it has an _Upgrade_ that makes the weapon return.

~Hemmingstep~.Effect: When standing right next to a wall, you take -1 Damage from all sources.

~Raise and Roil~.Effect: Single-Stun all Enemies you have hit with your Fierce Craft this Combat.
~Raise and Roil~.Combo: A Comboed Unit affected is also Slowed.
~Raise and Roil~.Notes:
A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.

~Command - Charge~.Effect: Choose a direction. You and all Allies may move up to 3 meters in that direction.

~Rending Edge~.Requirement: Only works if target can bleed
~Rending Edge~.Effect:
Make a {Type} {A}{A}Action Point weapon attack. It deals -50% Damage, but applies a Bleed effect on the target.
While Bleeding, it takes {Amount} True Damage at the end of your Turns.
~Rending Edge~.Notes: Remember which enemies have how much Bleed.

~Whirlwind~.Upgrade: The Ability is Whirlwind if a melee weapon is equipped, or Rain Death if a ranged weapon is equipped.
~Whirlwind~.Notes:
Each rolled die ^must^ be assigned to a Unit.
The Damage type depends on the weapon currently equipped. Doesn't apply weapon effects (the weapon only matters for the Damage type).

Variants.Name: Rain Death
Variants.Area: in a chosen 4x4 meter area (5 meter range to the edge).

~Break Mountains~.Effect:
Pick up an object 1x1x1 to 2x2x2 meters in size, and Slam it 6d6 meters in any direction.
{CriticalStrike} for each max die rolled, deal +1d6 Damage and, if it's an object, it breaks on impact!
~Break Mountains~.Upgrade: You can instead pick up an enemy and Slam it a number of meters equal to half the rolled dice.
~Break Mountains~.Notes: When something Slammed it hits a Unit, they both takes Damage equal to the number of meters left.

<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Effect:
When you get this, choose a Font Spell that costs 1 {Mana}Mana from any Magic Font, up to your Level.
That Ability becomes a ^physical version of itself^: instead of using magic to cast that Spell, you use your body, weapons, or tools! Be creative with how it works!
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAGIC>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

~Flurry of Blades~.Effect: Your next {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attack has {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} applied twice, and also deals the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Damage to all other Enemies within 2 meters of the main target.

~Command - Patience~.Effect: Count the Round number. A Unit you can see gains that many Shieldings that can block 3 Damage each.

<Quick Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Taunt a Unit you can see (that can see you)
<Quick Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.

~Bull Rush~.Effect: If you move at least 3 meters in a straight line and then Attack a Unit in front of you on the same line, the Attack gains +1 for every 3 meters moved in that line.
~Bull Rush~.Notes: Works if mounted or if using Abilities that dash or jump (in a straight line), but teleporting interrupts this.

~Colossal Strikes~.Effect:
Each _consecutive_ {Type} weapon attack or single-target Ability on the same Unit deals {Amount} to both you and the target for each previous consecutive attack you made on that Unit.
~Click on the Icon to select which variant you want to have have!~
~Colossal Strikes~.Combo: Any of your attacks consume the Combo to not Damage you!
~Colossal Strikes~.Notes:
Consecutive attacks mean that you haven't attacked another target. For example, say you attack a Goblin this Turn. Then you attack it again, and this attack deals +1d4 to you and the Goblin. Next Turn, you attack the Goblin again and deal +2d4 Damage, to you and it. If you now attack a different target, that consecutiveness resets back to baseline (no extra Damage). Even if you attack the Goblin again, you have to repeat the cycle.
Moving or using non-single-target Abilities does _not_ break the consecutiveness.

~Weaponmaster~.Effect: If your {Type} {A}{A}Action Point weapon attack can't Critical Strike, it gains the following effect.
~Weaponmaster~.EffectGreen: Critical Strike - if you rolled maximum on at least one die, deal {Amount} Damage.

<Run Towards Glory>.Effect:
When Worthy Combat starts, a _Glory Point_ appears directly behind the furthermost Enemy from you.
The first time you reach the _Glory Point_, Heal for 1d10.
<Run Towards Glory>.Notes: The Glory Point is just a space/zone.

~Thicker Than Water~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Thicker Than Water~.Effect: Whenever you take Damage on your Turn, deal 50% of that to the last Unit you attacked as Fire Damage.

~Lead Commander~.Requirement: Can only trigger in Worthy Combat
~Lead Commander~.Effect: Whenever you use a Command Ability, give yourself or an affected Unit one Shielding that can block 1d6 Damage.

~Execute~.Effect:
Your next weapon attack kills the target if it leaves it with at most 1 {Health}Health.
If it dies, increase that number by +1 permanently.
~Execute~.Notes: Remind the Quest Master about this Ability when you think the enemy should die.

<Opportunity Attack>.Effect:
Use when an enemy within 1 meter moves away from you or makes a Ranged attack.
Make a {1AP} weapon attack on it.
<Opportunity Attack>.Upgrade: You can quickly equip a {1AP} weapon and attack with it.

~Chainwaver~.Effect: Slam a Unit 1d8 meters towards another Unit that isn't near it.
~Chainwaver~.Downside: At the end of the Turn you used this, it goes on Cooldown until the next Combat.
~Chainwaver~.Notes: You can Slam yourself! Or another Unit into you. You can use this as many times as you want, but all uses must be on the same Turn.

~Division and Conquest~.Effect:
Choose a Unit within your {Type} ^weapon^'s Range and spend all your remaining {A}Action Points.
For each spent, Damage them for {Amount} (weapon's Damage Type) and inflict a random Control Effect from below:
~Division and Conquest~.Upgrade: 1. Lagged, 2.Deafened, 3. Dazed, 4.Single-Stunned, 5. Slowed, 6. Blinded, 7. Crippled, 8. Silenced, 9. Rooted, 10. Frailed.
~Division and Conquest~.Notes:
Epic Units can't be Silenced or Rooted, and instead become Deafened or Lagged respectively.
A Lagged Unit's next Movement costs +1 Action Point.
A Deafened Unit's next Ability costs +1 Action Point.

A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.
A Slowed Unit has -50% Movement Speed until its next Movement.
A Frail Unit takes +50% Damage the next time it does.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -50% Damage/Healing.
A Blind Unit's next Damage/Heal Act deals -100% Damage/Healing.
A Silenced Unit can't use Abilities.
A Rooted Unit can't use Movement.

<Intercept>.Effect:
Dash towards a Unit.
Slam it away from you a number of meters equal to how many meters you just dashed.

<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Effect:
When you get this, choose ~two~ Class Talents that cost 1 {Mana}Mana from (any Specialization of) Cleric, Mage or Warlock, up to your Level.
Those Abilities become ^physical versions of themselves^: instead of using magic to cast that spell, you use your body/weapons/tools!
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Upgrade: The Damage of that Spell becomes Slash, Smash or Pierce, whichever makes sense.
<MIGHT OVER MAAAGIC!!!>.Notes:
E.g. Scorching Rays - you shoot 3 arrows with your bow (Pierce Damage). Be creative, come up with a description of how it works!
You can change this Ability inbetween Adventures.

~Command - Focus Fire~.Effect:
Choose a target and spend any number of {A}Action Points.
For each spent, command another Ally (all different) in your party to make a 1 {A}Action Point Act on that target.

~Groundbreaker~.Effect: When falling, your impact makes a crater a number of meters in diameter equal to the fallen distance, 2 meters deep at the edges, and Damages all other Units caught in the crater for your Falling Damage taken.
~Groundbreaker~.Notes: Only triggers if you take Falling Damage.

~Heavenbreaker~.Effect:
Spend any number of {A}Action Points.
For each spent, Slam yourself 1d8 meters upward.
~Heavenbreaker~.Upgrade: If you went above 10 meters up into the air, you land at the start of your next Turn.

~Breathing Technique~.Effect: You can breathe underwater for up to 1d20 minutes and swim at your normal speed.

<Overthrow>.Effect: When you Slam a Unit into a wall, it becomes Single-Stunned instead of taking Damage.
<Overthrow>.Notes: A Single-Stunned Unit has -1 Action Point on its (next) Turn.

~Command - Formation~.Effect: All Allies within 10 meters immediately move to form one of these formations with you:
List: Line: line with no space between Units!
V: V with no space between Units!
Box: equilateral square, extra Units in the middle!

<Into the Fray>.Effect:
When Combat starts, determine which side is your Ally Side and which is the Enemy Side of the battlefield (the line is drawn in the middle).
While in the Ally Side, Second Wind heals you for 2d6 Health.
While in the Enemy Side, your {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks have their ^Dice Upgraded^ to the next die type.
<Into the Fray>.Notes: Having Dice Upgraded means, for example, d6's become d8's, or d10's become d12's. D12's and d20's just gain +1.

<Expert Maneuvers>.Effect: Immediately after you make a weapon attack, choose one effect to apply.
SingleTable: Taunt up to 1d4 Units you can see
<Expert Maneuvers>.Notes: Taunted means its next offensive Act has Cover if it's not on you.

<Command - Attack>.Effect:
An ally immediately makes an Act that takes 2 {A}Action Points (can spend {Mana}Mana, Cooldowns, etc on it, as if it were on its Turn).
You can use this at any point, before or after someone does an Act.
^You^ roll all the dice for this Act.

~Unstoppable Juggernaut~.Effect: Whenever ^you^ kill a Worthy Enemy, take 1d6 Damage and gain +1 {A}Action Point this Turn.

<Row Control>.Effect: Your Slams deal +50% Damage. Your pushes can become Slams.

<Supreme Tactician>.Effect:
Use after you manually use a Command Ability you haven't used this Combat.
Recast the previous Command Ability you used.
<Supreme Tactician>.Notes:
If it requires spending {A}Action Points, consider it spends 1 {A}Action Point for free.
Does not trigger on triggered Commands (e.g. from Phalanx Discipline).

<Gravetaker>.Effect: Grab a Unit and SLAAAMM it into the ground 1d8 meters + 1d8 meters for each {A}Action Point you spent this Combat (including this Ability's {A}Action Points).

~Meat Grinder~.Effect: You Heal for all the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} extra Damage done.
~Meat Grinder~.Upgrade: {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Mass Damage done Heal you for 50% of the total Damage done instead.

~Painfeast~.Effect: Until the start of your next Turn, all Damage you take is transformed into Healing instead!

~Preparing For War~.Effect: Until the end of your next Turn, your {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} attacks apply the {Color('#ff5900' 'Fierce')} Damage thrice.

~ABSOLUTE UNIT~.Effect: THIS TURN, YOU DEAL +50% DAMAGE _(except to yourself)_!

~Phalanx Discipline~.Effect: After you do the same Ability or weapon attack 3 times on the same Turn, freely cast a Command Ability you have used this Combat.
~Phalanx Discipline~.Notes: If it requires spending {A}Action Points, consider it spends 1 {A}Action Point for free.

~Third Wind~.Effect: You have +1 {A}Action Point each Turn, but you can no longer spend {Mana}Mana.

<Perfect Strike>.Effect:
Your next weapon attack this Turn deals +300% Damage. If it kills the target, overkill Damage is dealt to all enemies within 3 meters of the main target.
Also, passively, you gain +2 Instinct and you are immune to monster _weapon effects_ (e.g. critical strikes).
<Perfect Strike>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<Master Tactician>.Effect:
Gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks for every 3 sessions the Campaign has progressed.
From now on, at the end of every session, gain +4 Max Health and +1 Damage on all attacks.
Also, passively, gain +2 Focus and you know the Abilities and strategies of all enemies you encounter.
<Master Tactician>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.

<Greatwielder>.Effect:
You can wield Two-Handed weapons, one in each hand.
Attacks like this take only a 1 {A}Action Point and count as One-Handed weapon attacks but deal -2 Damage.
While dual wielding Two-Handed weapons, if any Ability tells you to perform an attack with a Two-Handed and the ability costs 2 {A}Action Points, it costs only 1 {A}Action Point.
Also, passively, gain +1 Might and +1 Instinct.
<Greatwielder>.Downside: This is your Heroic Class Ability and, after getting this Talent, you can no longer change your Talents inbetween Adventures.
